=====================================================
  BlackHole - Zero-Knowledge Native P2P File Transfer
=====================================================
Version: 1.0.0 (Portable x64)

How to use:
1. Double-click BlackHole.exe to launch.
2. Ensure both devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi
   or Mobile Hotspot.
3. Select files, choose the peer on the radar, and transfer!

Zero cloud. Zero tracking. Zero internet data usage.
